rubric.evidence: Every claim traces to a primary source fetched live on 2026-07-26: the Pointer Events Editor's Draft carries the merged normative text (attribute definition verbatim: true iff synthesized by the platform to simulate scroll inertia after the user ended the physical scroll interaction; un-initialized MUST be false; WheelEventInit momentum = false). Runtime feature WheelEventMomentum is stable at trunk (crbug.com/40704952). Listing status (Enabled by default), detail status (Proposed, desktop+Android 151), and BCD support (chrome 151/mirrors/ff-safari false) are kept separate. The ChromeStatus spec_link's #dom-wheelevent-momentum anchor does not resolve in the current draft — documented rather than papered over.
Feature id 6631012282007552 appears in the v151 milestone listing under 'Enabled by default'; route slug derives from the listing name per the documented slug rule; H1 is the listing name verbatim.

Exact surface inventory: one attribute (WheelEvent.momentum) and one dictionary member (WheelEventInit.momentum) — verified against the spec's WheelEvent IDL, no further members. Overview links the stable member page (momentum/), which covers all nine dimensions for both items plus a dedicated #init section for the dictionary member. reference-contract.json maps 7 sources, 2 inventory items, 18 dimension coverages; deliberately partial pending independent review.

The overview motivates the feature from the developer problem (inertia events indistinguishable from physical input; heuristic workarounds) and states the two-valued semantics precisely, including the script-constructed-event default. The member page documents the false-does-not-prove-physical trap with the correct feature-detection pattern.

Overview embeds the identity-verified showcase momentum-tracker (200, same chromestatus id) with a linked source label; snippets show the physical-vs-inertia branch and the constructor init, both from the documented contract.

Real BCD-backed table (api/WheelEvent.json: chrome 151, edge mirror, chrome_android/webview mirrors, firefox/safari false, Deno/Node explicitly unknown) with each fact linked. Vendor signals cite the ChromeStatus API record (FF Positive / Safari No signal / web-devs Positive) and are kept separate from BCD rows. Absent WPT coverage is recorded honestly.

Direct primary-source link contract: the resolvable spec section (#interface-wheelevent), runtime_enabled_features.json5, crbug, BCD file, ChromeStatus page + API record, CodePen sample, MDN general WheelEvent (labelled as not covering momentum), and both showcase routes — each named source separately linked, target=_blank rel=noopener, zero plain-text labels.
Single main and h1 per page; sequential h1→h2; tables with captions and scoped headers; banner role=note with aria-label; descriptive iframe title.

First-column width hints and compat-table column min-widths applied from the start (cycle-8/9 lessons); MCP matrix at 1280x800 and 390x844 verifies no document overflow on both routes; pre blocks scroll internally by design.

Iframe src is the feature's own stable showcase route (momentum-tracker), identity-matched to chromestatus id 6631012282007552 and HEAD-verified 200 alongside the feature-detect sibling (linked in See also). cpsFeature.conformanceRoute is the feature-level route (verified 200). No repointing, no forked platform assertions.
